blackholeCommandDescription: Manual compact with structural summary. Subcommands: [settings] config overlay, [changelog] display changelog, [cleanup] remove orphaned files, [om-off]/[om-on] disable/enable observational memory.
memoryCommandDescription: Show memory pipeline status & token counters. /blackhole-memory [view] visible observations & reflections, [full] complete recorded memory (copies to clipboard).
exportCommandDescription: Export distilled project memory (observations/reflections from past sessions) to markdown. Usage: /blackhole-export [out:<path>]. If no out: is provided, writes to the project local cwd.
recallCommandDescription: Search session history. Defaults to active lineage. Usage: /blackhole-recall <query> [page:N] [scope:all] [mode:file|touched]
omDisabled: Observational memory disabled. Use /blackhole om-on to re-enable.
configSaveFailed: Failed to save config — the config file may be read-only (e.g., managed by Nix). Runtime state updated for this session only.
subcommandNoArgs: /blackhole {name} accepts no arguments. Did you mean "/blackhole {name}"?
exportStarting: Exporting project memory… this may take a few minutes depending on the number of session files for the project.
exportPathNotMarkdown: Export path must be a markdown file: {path}. Use out:<path-to-file>.md
exportScanningMarkers: Scanning {total} session files for observational memory markers…
exportNoneFound: No observational memory found for {project} ({sessions} sessions scanned).
exportObservationsLine: - observations: {total} → {rendered} rendered ({duplicates} duplicates collapsed, {filtered} below viability gate{covered})
exportTopicGroups: - {count} topic groups identified; each observation shows its **topic badge**
exportUnattributed: - unattributed pending memory: {observations} obs / {reflections} reflections from {sessions} lost session(s)
exportFooter: The file is plain markdown — curate it, then import into any memory system.
cleanupNone: pi-blackhole: No orphaned pending files found.
cleanupListFooter: Use /blackhole cleanup in TUI mode to delete these files.
cleanupDeletedPartial: pi-blackhole: Deleted {deleted}/{intended} orphaned pending file{plural} ({failed} failed).
cleanupAllRemoved: pi-blackhole: All {count} orphaned pending file{plural} removed.
omStageKeptFailed: Observational memory: {stage} kept its {kept}, but a later turn failed ({detail})
omFailDeterministicCooled: deterministic error, model cooled down; details in cooldown log
omFailTransientDebug: transient error; details in debug log
omFailTransientNoDebug: transient error; enable debugLog for details
projectConfigFileInvalid: Project config file ".pi/{filename}" is {error}. Using defaults.
manualAlreadyCompacted: blackhole: already compacted — nothing new to compact since the last summary
manualNothingToCompact: blackhole: nothing to compact yet — Pi's keep-recent budget still covers this branch
migrationReminder: blackhole: Use `/blackhole configure` to save your updated configuration.
compactionStats: blackhole: {summarized} source entries processed; tail kept {kept}/{total} user turns{smart}{all} (~{tokens} tok).
ownCutNoLiveMessages: blackhole: Nothing to compact (no live messages)
ownCutTooFewLiveMessages: blackhole: Too few live messages — Pi's default logic preserves visible context. Set tailBehavior to "minimal" in config to force compaction with fewer messages.
appendSummaryFallback: pi-blackhole: append summary mode fell back to a complete replacement summary ({reason}); run /blackhole to rebase back into append segments
contextStillTooLarge: blackhole: estimated context still exceeds available capacity after compaction; Pi overflow retry/error handling remains in control
staleCompactionSkipped: Observational memory: auto-compaction skipped — the extension ctx went stale before the deferred compaction ran (in-memory sessions disposed right after agent_end lose this race); see /blackhole-memory status
adapterFallbackNonPersisted: ; non-persisted sessions will not be compacted
midRunInlineUnavailable: Observational memory: mid-run inline compaction unavailable: {reason}{fallback}
midRunThresholdReached: Observational memory: compaction threshold reached mid-run (~{tokens} tokens); compacting{mode}
midRunInlineComplete: Observational memory: transparent mid-run compaction complete
midRunInlineFailed: Observational memory: transparent mid-run compaction failed: {message}{retry}
midRunPausedComplete: Observational memory: mid-run compaction complete; agent paused
autoCompactionThresholdReached: Observational memory: compaction threshold reached (~{tokens} tokens); triggering compaction
compactionSessionChanged: Observational memory: compaction cancelled — session changed before compaction
compactionAlreadyRan: Observational memory: compaction skipped — another compaction already ran before deferred compaction
omSkippingFailedCycle: Observational memory: {stage} skipping {model} (failed this cycle, cooldown disabled)
omSkippingCooldown: Observational memory: {stage} skipping {model} (cooldown — details in cooldown log)
omAllCandidatesFailed: Observational memory: {stage} skipped — all candidates failed (sessionFallback disabled, won't use main model)
omStageUnavailableRetry: Observational memory: {stage} skipped — model unavailable (cooldown set to 0, {fallbacks}, will retry next run)
observerRunning: Observational memory: observer running on ~{chunk}-token chunk (of {total} accumulated)
observerInputTooLarge: Observational memory: observer skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)
observerNoToolCall: model did not call the observation tool
observerDuplicates: {count} observation(s) were duplicates of already-recorded entries
observerEmptyArray: model called the tool but submitted an empty observations array
reflectorRunning: Observational memory: reflector running (~{total} tokens accumulated, ~{input}-token input)
reflectorInputTooLarge: Observational memory: reflector skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)
dropperRunning: Observational memory: dropper running (~{total} tokens accumulated, ~{input}-token input)
dropperInputTooLarge: Observational memory: dropper skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)
configInvalidJson: blackhole: config file at {path} has invalid JSON: {error}. Using defaults.
memoryPassive: Passive: automatic memory workers and auto-compaction disabled
memoryPipelineDescription: Transcript accumulated since last run. Triggers when exceeding threshold.
memoryDropperProgress: Dropper:        pool {pool}% — eligible at ≥{eligible}% with new data; {pressure} ({progress}/{threshold} new tokens)
memoryPreambleCap: Preamble cap: {tokens} tokens per section (observations, reflections){note}
thresholdMigrationNotice: pi-blackhole: auto-compaction can now derive its threshold from your model's context window (preset curve — no fixed threshold needed). If you pinned a threshold or turned compaction off, reconsider: /blackhole settings → Compaction. Details: /blackhole changelog.
fieldCompactionDescription: auto=trigger on threshold, manual=only /blackhole, off=auto:Pi handles, /blackhole:blackhole pipeline
fieldCompactionSummaryModeDescription: default=replace one complete summary, append=freeze automatic segments and rebase on /blackhole
fieldTailBehaviorDescription: minimal=keep last user message only (default), pi-default=keep Pi's preserved visible context
fieldTailBehaviorOptionMinimal: minimal — keep last user message only (default)
fieldTailBehaviorOptionPiDefault: pi-default — keep Pi's preserved visible context
fieldMidRunCompactionDescription: resume=compact transparently and continue the same run, pause=interrupt and stop, off=only check when run ends (default)
fieldMidRunCompactionOptionOff: off — only check when run ends (default)
fieldShowPreCompactionMessageDescription: Display-only copy (max 16 KiB) of the newest assistant output the compaction dropped. Never enters model context or memory.
fieldShowPreCompactionMessageOn: Shown — recent output re-rendered below the compaction card
fieldCompactAfterTokensDescription: Explicit fixed token threshold; wins over the window-derived knobs and the preset curve. 0 = not set (a preset curve, ratio, or reserve governs).
fieldRetainedToolOutputMaxTokensDescript: Token budget for historical tool-output text; newest is retained first and older text remains available via recall
fieldCompactAfterRatioDescription: Compact when the session reaches this fraction of the active model's context window (e.g. 0.65 on a 200k model fires at ~130k). 0 = not set. An explicit token threshold wins; beats the reserve knob and the preset curve.
fieldCompactReserveTokensDescription: Alternative window-derived knob: compact when only this many tokens of headroom remain (threshold = window − reserve). 0 = not set. An explicit token threshold wins; ratio wins when both are set.
fieldCompactAfterPresetDescription: Window-scaled curve that sets the threshold when no numeric knob above is set (default: compact at 90% of a 32k window, falling to 40% at 1M). To edit the curve or add presets, hand-edit compactAfterPresets in the config file.
fieldMemoryDescription: Enable OM workers (observer, reflector, dropper) and content injection
fieldMemoryOn: Active — OM workers + content injection enabled
fieldSessionFallbackDescription: off=skip stage when all OM models fail, instead of falling back to the main coding model
fieldObserveAfterTokensDescription: Tokens accumulated since last observer run before triggering next observe
fieldReflectAfterTokensDescription: Tokens accumulated since last reflect before triggering reflector and dropper
fieldObservationsPoolMaxTokensDescriptio: Full-fold pressure and max estimated rendered observation-line tokens in compaction output
fieldReflectionsPoolMaxTokensDescription: Max estimated rendered reflection-line tokens in compaction output. 0 disables the cap. Full source records remain available through recall.
fieldObservationsPoolTargetTokensDescrip: Target tokens after dropper prunes (defaults to half of pool max)
fieldReflectorInputMaxTokensDescription: Max prompt tokens for reflector model input (rolling window cap)
fieldDropperInputMaxTokensDescription: Max prompt tokens for dropper model input (rolling window cap)
fieldObserverChunkMaxTokensDescription: Max source entry tokens sent to observer per chunk
fieldObserverPreambleMaxTokensDescriptio: Preamble budget in manual compaction mode (0=auto-compute 30% of chunk)
fieldDropperPressureThresholdDescription: Fraction of observationsPoolMaxTokens that triggers pressure-driven dropper (1 disables)
fieldDropperPoolFullnessThresholdDescrip: Min observation-pool fullness (fraction of pool max) before the dropper runs (0-1, default 0.10)
fieldAgentMaxTurnsDescription: Shared turn cap for background memory agents
fieldProviderIdleTimeoutMsDescription: Body-idle timeout for background provider streams; 0 = disabled, unset = inherit pi's default
fieldCacheRetentionDescription: Provider-neutral prompt-cache retention for the memory workers; unset defers to pi's effective setting. Adapters ignore values they do not support.
fieldCacheRetentionOptionNone: none — no prompt caching where supported
fieldWorkerAttemptTimeoutMsDescription: Hard elapsed deadline per worker/model attempt; timeout aborts the call and tries the next fallback; 0 = disabled
fieldFullFoldAlwaysDescription: When true, early reflections/drops survive the first compaction in a fresh session
fieldStatusBarDescription: Show token gauges (O/P/X) and worker events in the footer
fieldShowWorkerNotificationsDescription: Show routine observer/reflector/dropper progress toasts; warnings, errors and compaction notices always show
fieldShowWorkerNotificationsOn: On — routine worker progress toasts shown
fieldDebugLogDescription: Write structured JSONL debug logs to agent directory
scopeNotePending: in-memory until session file exists — will persist automatically
scopeNoteSessionOverrides: in-memory per-leaf overrides (persisted to session JSONL as {entryType})
cleanupListHint: ↑↓ navigate  Enter delete  D delete all  Esc cancel
recallNoFileOps: No file operations found in session history.
recallNoMatches: No matches for "{query}" in session history.
recallCapNote: — showing {shown} of {total} matches, refine your query for more precise results
recallPageOutOfRange: Page {page} is outside the available range 1-{totalPages} ({count} matches{scope}{cap}). {guidance}
recallPageGuidanceTruncated: Use /blackhole-recall {query}{scope} page:N with N between 1 and {totalPages}.
recallPageGuidance: Use /blackhole-recall {query}{scope} page:N with N between 1 and {totalPages}, or refine your query.
